title: More Context, Larger Models, or Moral Knowledge? A Systematic Study of Schwartz Value Detection in Political Texts
abstract: arXiv:2605.22641v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Detecting Schwartz values in political texts is hard: cues are often implicit, and neighboring values differ by fine distinctions. Two remedies are widely assumed to help: more surrounding document text, and explicit moral knowledge. Knowledge-based retrieval has improved benchmarks elsewhere, but whether either transfers here is untested, because published systems vary context, knowledge, and model family at once. We separate these factors under matched conditions on the ValuesML/Touch\'e ValueEval format. The input ranges from the target sentence to a local window to the full document. Retrieval is either absent or drawn from a curated moral knowledge base, injected by early, late, or cross-attention fusion. Supervised DeBERTa-v3 encoders are compared against zero-shot LLMs from 12B to 123B. translated_title: 更多上下文、更大的模型，还是道德知识？政治文本中施瓦茨价值观检测的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 在政治文本中检测施瓦茨价值观十分困难：线索往往隐含，相邻价值观之间仅存在细微差别。人们普遍认为有两种补救措施有效：更多的文档上下文文本，以及显式的道德知识。基于知识的检索已在其他基准测试中带来改进，但两者能否迁移到该任务尚未得到验证，因为已发表的系统中同时改变了上下文、知识和模型系列。我们在ValuesML/Touché ValueEval格式的匹配条件下对这些因素进行了分离。输入范围从目标句子到局部窗口再到完整文档。检索要么缺失，要么来自精心整理的道德知识库，并通过早期、晚期或交叉注意力融合的方式注入。研究将监督式DeBERTa-v3编码器与从12B到123B参数的零样本大语言模型进行比较。结果表明，更多的上下文并非普遍有益：完整文档输入使编码器提升了2.5-3.8个宏F1点，但并不能持续带来帮助。
tldr: 该研究在受控条件下系统分离了上下文长度、道德知识与模型规模三个因素，发现在政治文本的施瓦茨价值观检测任务中，更多上下文并非总是有益——完整文档输入仅使监督式编码器提升2.5-3.8个宏F1点，而对零样本大语言模型帮助并不一致。
en_tdlr: Under matched conditions, this systematic study disentangles context length, moral knowledge, and model scale for Schwartz value detection in political texts, showing that more context is not uniformly better—full-document input improves supervised encoders by 2.5-3.8 macro-F1 points but does not consistently help zero-shot LLMs.
